goblin-horde.name: Goblin Horde
goblin-horde.tagline: A goblin warband led by its Chieftain, with a shaman, a sharpshooter, a hexer, a cutthroat and an ogre for hire.

poisonOnHit.name: Dirty Arrows
poisonOnHit.description: Its hits also poison the target: 2 damage a round for 2 rounds

crypt.name: The Crypt
crypt.tagline: A necromancer's tomb where the dead won't stay down. Fire and holy power end them for good.

goblin.name: Skeleton
goblin.description: Rattles toward whoever taunted it, then the Warrior, then the lowest-HP hero

boneHarvest.name: Bone Harvest
boneHarvest.description: Heals 2 whenever a skeleton crumbles from weapon hits; fire and holy kills give it nothing

restless.name: Restless
restless.description: A weapon kill leaves a bone pile: it reassembles once at half HP next round. Fire and holy damage end it for good

assassin.name: Wraith
assassin.description: Intangible: only spells and Cleric attacks can touch it, and the first such hit makes it solid. Each round it drains every hero, ignoring armor, and heals itself

shaman.name: Wight
shaman.description: Heals the most injured undead and shields the horde (+2 armor through next round)

aura.name: Unholy Vigor
aura.description: +1 damage for every skeleton while the Wight lives

dragon-lair.name: The Dragon's Lair
dragon-lair.tagline: A red dragon's mountain lair, guarded by kobold zealots and drakes. Bring something other than fire.

goblin.name: Kobold
goblin.description: Small and fragile, but every kobold still standing tithes a coin to the Dragon's hoard. Attacks whoever taunted it, then the Warrior, then the lowest-HP hero

moltenHide.name: Molten Hide
moltenHide.description: Heroes who hit it with a weapon take 2 burn damage

shinyThief.name: Shiny Thief
shinyThief.description: While the Dragon sleeps, each hit that drains energy also adds a coin to the hoard

shaman.name: Scale Priest
shaman.description: Heals the most injured monster (the Dragon included) and shields the horde (+2 armor through next round)

giants-hall.name: The Giant's Hall
giants-hall.tagline: A frost giant lord's mead hall. Few foes, each a mountain. Bring them down together.

goblin.name: Ice Wolf
goblin.description: Hunts in pairs: attacks whoever taunted it, then the Warrior, then the lowest-HP hero

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Heals 4 at the end of each round, unless it was toppled or took fire damage that round

shaman.name: Skald
shaman.description: Heals the most injured giant and shields the horde (+2 armor through next round)

rallyingSaga.name: Rallying Saga
rallyingSaga.description: While the Skald lives, every giant needs 5 more damage to topple
